name: Pavel Hartmann
headline: Backend Engineer
summary: Backend engineer with experience building reliable server-side features, improving data flows, and supporting product teams across several fast-moving environments. Comfortable working across APIs, messaging, and data storage while keeping delivery practical and maintainable. Known for clear collaboration, steady execution, and thoughtful system improvement.

Supported bug fixes and release preparation, and kept PostgreSQL routines stable for the product team.
